title: Support Worker
description:
About this role
Search Consultancy are currently recruiting for Support Workers to join our ever expanding Bank Hours team within the Huddersfield area. We are currently operating a fast track recruitment process with next day interviews available and free DBS checks.
We are recruiting Support Workers on a temporary / ad hoc basis to work in various private healthcare settings, supporting service users with mental health illnesses and learning difficulties.
Key Responsibilities
Support individuals with daily living tasks
Assist with mobility and safe moving & handling
Support with meals and hydration
Promote independence and encourage choice
Monitor wellbeing and report concerns appropriately
Maintain accurate records and follow care plans
The suitable candidates will:
Have worked a minimum of 6 months recent experience in a healthcare setting.
Have a flexible approach towards work.
Be able to travel via own or public transport in local and surrounding areas to your home.
What we offer:
Free DBS check (Limited time only)
Free specialist training programmes.
100% Flexible working hours to fit around any lifestyle.
Experience in a variety of high quality Support and Care environments.
Competitive rates of pay.
You will need to have a minimum of six months' recent UK experience working within a healthcare environment in a similar capacity. Shortlisted applicants will be required to attend a video interview.
All positions are subject to an enhanced DBS check and we require a minimum of two satisfactory employment references. Although shifts are offered on an ad hoc basis, work is constantly ongoing.
(AGY) Search is an equal opportunities recruiter and we welcome applications from all suitably skilled or qualified applicants, regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/beliefs, sexual orientation or age.
Support Worker (Agency) - Huddersfield Flexible Shifts Weekly Pay
Looking for flexible work that fits around your lifestyle?
Search Consultancy is expanding its Bank Support Worker team in the Wakefield area and we're looking for experienced Support Workers to join us.
Whether you're looking to top up your income, fit work around family commitments, or choose when and where you work, we offer flexible agency shifts across a range of high-quality healthcare services.
We're recruiting now with a fast-track recruitment process, next-day video interviews, and a free enhanced DBS for successful applicants (limited-time offer).
The Role
You'll support adults in specialist healthcare settings, working with individuals with mental health needs and learning disabilities. Every shift offers the opportunity to make a genuine difference while gaining experience across a variety of services.
Responsibilities
Supporting individuals with day-to-day living activities
Promoting independence, dignity and choice
Assisting with mobility and safe moving & handling
Supporting with meals, hydration and personal wellbeing
Observing and reporting changes in service users' wellbeing
Completing accurate records and following individual care plans

Search is an equal opportunities recruiter and we welcome applications from all suitably skilled or qualified applicants, regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/beliefs, sexual orientation or age.
